rows.description: The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work

Independent Auditing of AI Agents. Run by human or the agent itself, to answer the most crucial question in the AI Agent Economy. Is the agent doing what is supposed to do? With iFixAi you can have this answer in less than 120 seconds.

The open source AI engineering platform for agents, LLMs, and ML models. MLflow enables teams of all sizes to debug, evaluate, monitor, and optimize production-quality AI applications while controlling costs and managing access to models and data.
Graph-Native Infrastructure for Context and Accountable AI Systems

Open-source, high-performance AI gateway that works as your LLM gateway, MCP gateway and agent gateway. One OpenAI-compatible API for 10,000+ models, with failover, load balancing, semantic caching, virtual keys, budgets and MCP Code Mode. Works with any SDK or agent and adds under 200µs of overhead at 5k RPS.
Self-hosted TypeScript agent runtime with durable approvals and verifiable run records. Own it, approve it, audit it.
Self-hosted, open-source agent skill registry for enterprises. Publish & version skill packages, govern with RBAC and audit logs, deploy   on-premise with Docker or Kubernetes.

Synapsa Commons: free, hands-on AI courses that run anywhere (Colab, Kaggle, Binder, Codespaces, Jupyter). EU AI Act conformity evidence, model validation, predictive maintenance, document extraction, retrieval and RAG, AI agents and MCP, a simulated humanoid. Every lesson autograded. From the team building Synapsa.

LeanCTX is the Context Gateway for AI Systems. Select task-relevant context, apply supported controls, connect local knowledge and inspect recorded evidence. Open-source Engine: CLI, MCP, hooks and supported proxy paths.
The Enterprise Architecture Governance Harness — strategy, architecture, delivery, and assurance using AI coding assistants
The open-source governance layer for AI agents: write the rules declaratively, Bernstein enforces them and produces the verifiable, replayable record. Free, Apache-2.0. https://bernstein.run
